digest.component_or_area: contributor documentation and DCO signing policy
propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) that contradicts CONTRIBUTING.md's requirement for contributors to sign with their own real configured git identity.

Documentation across AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md presents inconsistent DCO sign-off contract: some files prescribe a hardcoded third-party identity while others require the committer's own identity.

Joe Oakhart's bot identity should be retained only in narrowly scoped automation files (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/) and must not appear in contributor-facing guidance under docs/ or CONTRIBUTING.md.

A deterministic build-integrated lint check must detect and fail on any hardcoded personal sign-off (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com or 'Signed-off-by: Joe Oakhart') in contributor-facing documentation, while explicitly excluding automation ownership paths and experiment corpora.
